<!-- pr-reviewer: 1515ba59579f750790e09de0023057ade23d8594 -->
**Needs changes before merge.** The code is right. The PR body is not: it is PR #1575's text (the Bore core door), so merging would close the wrong issue.

### What looks good
- `authored_law` is now real shared code: `Slot | Circular => authored_law(src)`, with Entity and Selection mapped to `Section` and Stock to `None`. `depth_law_of`'s `part_solid` early return still comes first.
- #1550 is closed on every route I tried. A picked Circular 3 mm (or 0.02 mm) below its floor gets 3079 blocking `Gouge`s on the operation itself. With the stock turned, the post is refused by name on the op's own moves (`C1: move N cuts past the finish surface`). MCP `verify` agrees.
- A tilted picked Circular is still refused at generate (`job.rs:212`, "a tilted plane cannot yet index a picked selection"). Its status is not `Ok`, so `uncovered()` refuses it as well. The framed branch feeds the local model to `Section` (`generate.rs:3230`).
- The Slot is unchanged. This holds by construction: `part_solid_of` (`boundary_ctx.rs:18`) is never true for `SrcRef::Stock`, so every reachable Slot source still maps to `Section`. Mutation F below (Slot hard-wired back to `Section`) is equivalent: every suite stays green.
- The pins are mutation-checked (table below). The provenance line and the Gate map are there, and the new test sits in `crates/app/tests` with app imports. No snapshot, CHANGELOG or process files are touched.

### Results merged with `upstream/main` 45a76e15 (clean trial merge, built locally on macOS)
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| circular_pick_law (new) | 4 passed |
| circular_entity_law | 4 passed |
| circular_pick | 4 passed |
| slot_picks / slot_pick_refusals / slot_caps | 8 / 3 / 4 passed |
| operations | 119 passed, 6 ignored |
| verify / mcp_verify / posting | 21 (2 ignored) / 3 / 17 passed |
| golden_cl / solid_law_goldens | 32 / 7 passed |
| mill2d_b / units_in_refusals | 9 / 5 passed |
| camcraft-app lib | 215 passed |
| clippy `-p camcraft-app --all-targets --no-deps -D warnings` | clean |

### Mutation check (each applied alone, then reverted)
| Mutation | Caught by |
|---|---|
| A: `Selection -> None` | lib (2), circular_pick_law (2), slot_picks `a_slot_through_the_pocket_wall_is_refused_and_one_below_the_floor_holds_the_post` |
| B: `Entity -> None` | lib (2), circular_entity_law (2), slot_picks `a_whole_part_slot_through_the_wall_is_convicted_and_holds_the_post` |
| C: `Stock -> Section` | lib only (`the_shared_authored_law_reads_the_source_alone`). Unreachable from `depth_law_of`, so an equivalent mutant in practice |
| D: `Entity, Selection -> Contain` | lib (3) only. **Survives every integration suite** (see note 2) |
| E: early return removed | lib, circular_pick_law `a_circle_picked_off_the_stock_is_never_judged`, posting (12 tests) |
| F: Slot arm back to a literal `Section` | nothing (equivalent, as above) |
| G: Circular arm -> `None` | lib (3), circular_pick_law (2), circular_entity_law (2) |
| H: Slot picks -> `None` | lib, slot_picks (1) |

### Requested before merge
1. **Replace the PR body.** It is #1575's text: the Bore description, its tests, a Bore `Changelog:` line, and it ends `Fixes #1556`. On merge GitHub would close #1556 (still open; its fix is #1575) and never mention #1550 in the body. The commit message is correct (`Fixes #1550`, `Refs #1543`). Please write this PR's own body: what changed, the pins, what was not exercised, a `Changelog:` line for #1550 (for example "A Circular picked off the finished part is judged against it: a ring cut below the picked floor is a blocking gouge on the operation and the post is refused, even where the program sim cannot judge."), and end with `Fixes #1550` / `Refs #1543`.

### Notes (not blocking)
1. **False refusals on picked finishing (question 2): none are new.** I ran a picked R15 round pocket floor (6 mm end mill, bottom at the floor) at 32 to 128 chords, with stock to leave 0 / 0.01 / 0.02 / 0.05 / 0.5. The gouge count is **the same on this head and with picks forced back to `None`** (the pre-PR law):
   | chords (sagitta) | leave 0 | 0.01 | 0.02 | 0.05 | 0.5 |
   |---|---|---|---|---|---|
   | 32 (0.072) | 1026 | 1024 | 896 | 512 | 0 |
   | 48 (0.032) | 1024 | 768 | 384 | 0 | 0 |
   | 64 (0.018) | 768 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
   | 96 / 128 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

   The coarse-mesh refusal of a picked circle finished to size comes from the region and plane laws, which ran before this PR. The only difference is one extra non-gouge `RapidInStock` at 32 chords, leave 0, on a row that is refused anyway. The decision file's sentence "the same reading applies to a picked Circular finished to size" is true, but it reads as a new cost. Saying the picks already paid it would be more accurate.
2. **M4 survival (Contain vs Section).** The gouge verdicts were identical under `Contain` in every row I probed (40 picked rows, plus the existing suites). The two laws are not identical, though. On the picked R15/128-chord ring 0.02 mm below its floor (leave 0.5), `Section` reports 7 `RapidInStock` and `Contain` reports 6. The extra one is `RapidInStock { at: 7730 }`, from the model-fed rapid and hidden-stock laws only `Section` runs. So `Section` judged more than `Contain` here (the extra rapid), never less. Choosing it is the safe side, and pinning it at the unit level is acceptable. If you want an integration pin, the non-gouge finding count on that row separates the two.
3. **A sibling gap outside this diff, probably P1: `TrochoidalSlot`.** It cuts endpoints and a width typed by hand, like the Slot, but falls to `_ => DepthLaw::None`. On the same fixture with a whole-model (`Entity("part")`) source and leave 0:
   - a slot from (-8,0) to (8,0), width 10, cut to Z1 under the Z4 floor: status ok, 0 findings. With the stock aligned, the post is blocked by the program sim (447 cells, 3.00 mm). **With the stock turned, it POSTED.**
   - a slot from (4,0) to (20,0), width 10, cut to Z4 (tool centre reaches x 20.14, through the pocket wall at R15): status ok, 0 findings, and **it POSTED with the stock aligned and with it turned.**

   This is the same hole #1550 described: `uncovered()` (`posting_sim.rs:118`) counts any fresh, stamped op as judged, whatever its depth law. It is not this PR's job. It needs its own issue (and possibly a look at why the program sim passes the through-wall case).
4. A selection that mixes a part pick with a pick on the stock gives `part_solid` false, so it is not judged. That is unchanged and the same for the Slot. Mentioned for completeness.
5. `generate.rs` is 3458 lines, far past ~400. This PR adds one net line. Flagged, not blocking.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
